author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
llm-wiki is OUT, llm-expert-system is IN

Why get the LLM write wiki pages when it can write a good old fashion expert system in Prolog, CLIPS, Z3 and Clingo?

I learnt expert system in my AI class 30 years ago. Do they still teach expert system in school these days?
